subject: Air freight quote: DUS to JFK
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option from DUS to JFK (New York, US)? The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-27, and we will deliver it to DUS ourselves.

It is 1 piece of electronic control units, with a gross weight of 1540 kg and a volume of 5.90 cbm.

Please let me know the earliest departure and arrival you can offer, together with your all-in price in EUR.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH
